name: ajo
description: Offline-first savings circle (ajo/esusu) ledger. Installable web app with multi-device merge and conflict resolution.

paragraphs: An offline-first ledger for ajo and esusu savings circles. Each member pays the same amount every week or month, one member collects the whole pot each round, and whoever keeps the book needs to know who has paid, who is short and whose turn it is. Usually all of that lives in an exercise book or a WhatsApp group. Ajo puts it in an installable web app that keeps working at the market with no signal, and that copes when two phones edit the same square while they're out of touch.
features: Contribution grid with paid, paid late (+N days), part paid, missed and due states, a "not synced yet" marker and a dashed outline for clashing squares. On phones it becomes one strip per member, with whoever owes money…

Recording payments with amount shortcuts, typed amounts like 20k or ₦20,000, cash/transfer/POS, reference, date paid and a live preview of how the square will read. Every save can be undone from the toast.
Rotation: whose turn it is, what's in the pot, who is still short, and a payout flow that asks before paying out less than the full pot. Turns that have been paid out are locked when you reorder.
Members: photos (resized on the device before they sync), phone numbers, a week-by-week history, reminders through the share sheet, and removing someone only while they have nothing on the books.
Starting and joining circles: a three-step setup with "draw lots" for the order, plus an invite QR code, link and code. Joining needs signal once; after that everything works offline.
